property_summary: In the reference, the transfer function calls 'transferFrom(address,address,uint256)' on the target contract, debiting from msg.sender; in the buggy version, it calls 'transfer(address,uint256)' which debits from the target contract itself, so when calling into a contract with both functions, the reference reverts (due to allowance/balance issues) while the buggy one succeeds, or vice versa.
change_summary: Change the selector to the 'transfer' function (not the standard ERC20 transferFrom) so that a different external function is called.
